spans.text: ...In a conference at the Pandora Organization.
Styx casually adjusts her hair and makeup in a compact mirror.
The people seated around her are still pestering her relentlessly.
Chairwoman Styx, the alliance representatives have lodged multiple complaints regarding the speech video you released without authorization. We must issue a proper response.
If they truly needed an answer, they wouldn't just be making complaints.
But Doctor Shaw was Martyr Sofya's younger sister... How could you slander her like this...?
Martyr Sofya's organization, the Moscovite Illuminati, is one of our strongest allies. Offending them over something like this is detrimental to our future cooperation.
Styx finally puts down the mirror. She beams brightly as she looks around at the others.
Please get your positions and relations straight. It's those underfunded, resource-strapped organizations that approached US seeking an alliance.
Besides, the Moscovite Illuminati was at its strongest when Martyr Sofya was still alive. Once she was gone, not a single one of them could hold things together.
You've seen it too—the anti-Relic campaign event they held last week? It was pathetic. A kindergarten sports day would've been more exciting.
...You're still avoiding the core issue.
Chairwoman Styx, why did you release that unapproved speech video at such a sensitive time?
I'm the Executive Chairwoman of Pandora. I believe I have the right to express my views when I deem it necessary.
But your views contain serious misinformation. Doctor Shaw may not have been a member of Pandora or any of its allied organizations, but she's always been a committed anti-Relic advocate—
Just like her sister. She just chose a different path.
Sisters who appear united yet pursue different goals—history is full of such examples.
So you're refusing to respond to the complaints?
Styx glances at the elegant watch on her wrist.
Everyone, let's not forget our focus right now—a new world is about to dawn, and the current world order will soon be reshuffled.
We fought hard for this invitation to Frankfurt.
And now, we've been occupying someone else's conference room for nearly half an hour.
Have they arrived?
Mhm, their assistant just messaged me.
This is a rare opportunity—whether we can secure a seat in the opposition in the coming new world...
Knock knock. The door to the conference room is rapped twice.
Come in.
Chairwoman Styx, the guests have arrived. Should I bring them in now?
After one final check to ensure that her makeup is flawless, Styx rises with perfect composure.
Of course. We're ready.
...After the conference.
Styx steps into an empty restroom. She stands before the mirror, but she isn't looking at her own reflection.
Ashley, have you received the full dossier on the attendees?
Yes, Sister Styx. I've received it and I'm uploading everything into the Bee Sting System now.
Good.
Sister Nemhran asked me to pass along several Bee Sting files to you.
Click, click. Styx flips through the documents sent to her.
It's intel on a Griffin PMC Commander and a mobile base vehicle designated "Elmo".
Sister Nemhran has flagged these individuals as highly likely to disrupt the plan. If you encounter them, please eliminate them immediately.
Understood.
After ending the call, Styx studies the Commander's dossier with growing interest.
Looks like an interesting one...
...In a laboratory at the Johannes Gutenberg University of Mainz.
The blinking cursor reaches the bottom of the test data screen. After hitting enter, Stevens M520 initiates a call.
Commander, the experiment is complete.
Please head to the Mainz University lab immediately to collect the subject.
Understood. I'm on my way.
By the way, how's Nele?
Um...
Stevens M520 glances at Nele, who is slumped over the desk, fast asleep.
Her mental state is relatively stable, but she's pulled several all-nighters, so she really needs some proper rest.
Alright, got it.
After ending the call, Stevens M520 walks over to Amaris, who is staring blankly out the window.
What, don't tell me there's more grunt work?
Nope. Our task is already finished.
...Mine isn't.
In fact, it's only just begun.
As they lapse into silence, a lively group of university students pass by outside the window, on their way to morning classes.
They walk in pairs or clusters, arm in arm or side by side.
I've learned all about your elder sister.
Huh.
I've got a younger sister myself. Rebellious, willful, defiant—pretty much as infuriating as you.
She was supposed to inherit Dr. Hume's estate. Could've lived freely as a noble lady.
But she insisted on destroying all of it—even at the cost of her own life.
I can sort of understand that kind of mindset.
Your sister is dead. My sister is dead.
Are you trying to one-up me in tragedy? I'm not sad at all. I didn't care much for Aliana.
No, I mean—
Stevens M520's face takes on a solemn expression that unsettles Amaris.
I wouldn't mind being your sister.
Sure, you're a bit of a mess, and your clothes are falling apart, but we've got a lot in common.
Maybe we can find in each other the answers we can no longer find in those who are gone.
I get that you're emotional right now. You don't have to give me an answer right away.
Amaris hesitates for a long while before finally muttering a few words.
I appreciate the sentiment, but I've vowed to myself that I'll never call anyone "sister" again!
A vow is only made to be broken, isn't it?
You—
Click. The Commander's comms request saves Amaris from replying.
Commander, have you arrived? Alright, we'll come meet you now.
The Commander steps into the lab. Nele is splashing cold water on her face to stay awake.
You look exhausted...
I'm fine. I can still manage.
Thank you for all your efforts... She'll be the most critical shot we have...
Did I make it in time?
You've exceeded all my expectations!
...Only her capabilities were restored... Everything else...
I've kept blank. Left just enough for her to be a tool to be wielded.
I didn't want to insult my mentor's memory.
I understand... That's more than enough.
I will crush Paradeus... I will not let your work be in vain.
Commander...
Nele walks up to the Commander. Her steps are a bit unsteady, but the resolve in her eyes remains undimmed.
I have one more request.
... Boom!
Bang-bang-bang.
The silence of the factory is shattered by a sudden burst of gunfire.
Several Nytos quickly organize a response team and rush into the smoke with weapons in hand...
Bang-bang-bang—
After another round of gunfire, silence once again falls over the factory.
A Doll of immense stature drags the still remains of a white Nyto toward the control terminal, using its credentials to activate the system.
That should do it.
Hm.
Clatter. The now-worthless Nyto is tossed aside.
A shadow appears soundlessly at the dissipating edge of the smoke, lifting her gaze toward the surveillance camera—
End of surveillance footage.
...Inside a Paradeus factory.
Nemhran watches the surveillance footage that Hebe provided in silence.
In a single day, nearly 70% of the factories in Frankfurt have been attacked.
The method is consistent—first a hacker team breaches the system to disable alarms, followed by three monstrous Dolls who storm in and destroy everything.
They don't linger; their goal is clear—destroy the production line and retreat.
Their attacks are clearly aimed at disrupting Project Cocoon. I have to admit, it's an effective tactic.
How much impact on phase three?
The materials for phase three are already mostly prepared. Including what's in storage, it should just barely be enough.
But with over half the production lines crippled, recovery will take significant time. For now, we can't supply any additional materials for Project Cocoon.
As long as it's enough to complete phase three.
All the necessary materials are en route. They'll reach the designated lab by the end of the day.
However, if our system logs the location of the new lab, those Dolls will come swarming like hyenas smelling blood...
I know. I'll relocate that site as quickly as possible.
And once phase three is complete, erase all traces of the factory.
...Understood.
Hebe responds, but makes no move to leave.
You have something to say.
Just feeling a bit sentimental. We've been running this operation for years.
It feels like playing a simulation game until near completion... and then someone hits the reset button.
You should've known from the start—everything we've done was for this very moment.
I know that, of course.
But still, this moment comes so suddenly. Like a comet—is it a good omen or a bad one? There's just no telling.
Hebe glances at the screen, where Nemhran's face is reflected—silent and composed.
Normally by now you'd be telling me not to waste time on meaningless thoughts.
Why so quiet today?
...Because I'm starting to suspect...
...That we have a traitor in our midst.
...You're joking, right?
On the outside, we have Bee Sting. On the base level, we had the Lake of Cognition, and now we have Cocoon.
If you suspect someone... can't you just look directly?
...Hebe, back when I was still in Moscow...
didn't I tell you to read more on the subject of human history when you had the time?
...Mhm, you did.
But I always thought it was pointless. With how far technology has come, schemes and tricks are obsolete.
Now it's all about tech
Just like how detective stories became irrelevant with the advent of cameras and chemical analysis.
Nemhran sighs.
Methods do change with time and technology.
But the desires of the human heart are the same regardless of the times.
Are we... human?
...We are, albeit incomplete ones.
And since we are human, we naturally also carry human flaws.
Pride, envy, wrath, sloth, greed, gluttony, and lust.
We still hold some measure of each.
...So who do you think the traitor is?
...Forget it. Even if there is one... it shouldn't be me who exposes her.
So you have these human flaws too?
I suppose at this very moment... there is a fragment of wrath within me.
...You really don't let it show.
If your anger had a color, it'd probably be something close to white.
...No, it'd be the color of a flower.
...Never took you for a poet.
I need to handle the White Zone's secret passage first.
You are to supervise the mission of escorting Lady Laplace.
...So this is a last-minute assignment?
You were originally going to handle it yourself?
Yes, because the experimental subject cannot be risked.
...Understood.
Keep it covert. Your current combat style is still under wraps—don't show your hand prematurely.
And who are you sending to escort Lady Laplace?
Morridow and Bramedb.
...Got it.
Nemhran heads for the door.
Our fate might've been decided from the very beginning.
No matter how we struggle, we are but helpless creatures caught in a spider's web, awaiting fate's final decree.
Hebe looks back toward Nemhran. All she has left behind is a few shimmering fragments fallen from the hem of her skirt.
Through the surveillance feed, Hebe watches Morridow and Bramedb successfully rendezvous with Laplace and escort her out of the lab.
Morridow immediately starts deploying her squad and configuring the transport convoy.
Hebe notices a new access log appear inside the base.
It's not from an ordinary Nyto, but—
...Gray?
Why hasn't her access been revoked? Could it have been hacked?
Hebe instantly pulls up the surveillance footage of "Gray" entering the base, while running a full system check at the same time.
Only when she sees that unmistakable face on the screen does Hebe finally believe it—
No hacking. No identity theft. Gray herself has returned to the Paradeus base.
The same Gray who was supposed to have perished in Avernus.
A wave of thoughts crash through Hebe's mind. Before she can fully process the reality of Gray's resurrection, she sees her heading toward Laplace's location.
Hebe immediately sounds the alarm for that area.
Ashley, notify Morridow at once. We have an enemy infiltration.
...Enemy? Understood!
In the surveillance feed, Morridow and Bramedb appear to have received the alert. They quickly change routes, guiding Laplace toward the emergency exit.
After Ashley's message, Morridow also brings forward the escort squad's rendezvous schedule.
But Hebe frowns—these measures won't be enough.
Whoosh. The hatch opens, and Morridow looks over—
Gray...?
...What are you doing here?
Morridow's eyes widen in shock, and Gray is already striding toward Laplace with her blade raised...
Morridow, you really would be perfect for a horror or disaster flick.
You're exactly the kind of brainless cannon fodder that dies in the opening scene.
Hebe grits her teeth as she leaves the surveillance room, racing toward Laplace's location with inhuman speed.
Gray raises her blade—and the next second, her figure vanishes, leaving only the roar of air being cleaved—
Boom!
Morridow barely manages to block her attack.
Why has her fighting style changed...?
This isn't Gray's usual move!
8 o'clock!
A split-second later, Morridow is knocked aside, slamming hard into Bramedb.
Gray charges again, aiming to strike at the defenseless Laplace—
Boom!
In front of the cleaved metal rack, Laplace is nowhere to be seen.
Hebe lands softly, placing herself between Gray and Laplace.
You're...
With reflexes that slow, it's a miracle you've survived this long.
Morridow looks at the poised, elegant woman before her—and smiles knowingly.
You must be the sister overseeing Project Cocoon in Frankfurt.
...The name is Hebe.
Thank you for saving me upon our first meeting, Sister Hebe.
Maybe thank yourself for not revoking Gray's access.
Otherwise, I wouldn't have had the chance to witness this insane plot twist of a dead Nyto returning to Paradeus.
...Don't blame me, Sister Hebe.
You know our system deletes a member's access automatically upon confirmation of death.
I don't have time for your excuses. Protect Lady Laplace.
Yes, Sister.
Bramedb, come with me. We'll take on this Gray together.
Morridow, take Lady Laplace and find another way out.
...Yes, Sister.
Morridow immediately puts an arm around Laplace's shoulders and vanishes from sight with her.
Bramedb watches Hebe from the corner of her eye. Her smile remains graceful and calm, but Bramedb can feel the overwhelming threat she exudes.
Gray is nothing like the one in previous records.
Watch out for her attacks; don't get caught. Just do your best to stall her and create an opening for me. I'll take care of the rest.
Understood!
